resources.string: Why this counter differs from your watch →
Between two synchronisations the device interpolates; the reference is the server, which follows the Earth’s rotation (UT1).
No IERS data: UT1 approximated by the machine clock.
Never synchronised: device clock only (UT1 ≈ UTC).
Put Zman on your home screen: the Hebrew date and the hour of the day, at a glance.
Or: touch and hold the home screen › Widgets › Zman.
The Hebrew date and the hour of the day, in rotation time.
